Donation and Refund Policy

Draft for foundation review. This policy is not approved for public use.

01 / Donation & Refund Policy

Donation and Refund Policy

Thank you for your interest in supporting Siliguri Aashray Welfare Foundation. Please confirm the approved contribution method and arrangements with our team before transferring funds or materials.

02 / Donation & Refund Policy

Accepted contributions

Preview · confirmation needed[List the approved contribution types, payment methods, currencies and donor eligibility once confirmed.]

The website’s support form is an enquiry. It does not itself process a donation or confirm acceptance of a contribution. Please do not use payment details received from an unverified source.

03 / Donation & Refund Policy

Purpose of support

If you would like your contribution to support a specific initiative, discuss that preference with our team before contributing. Any restriction on the use of funds must be accepted and recorded by the foundation.

Preview · confirmation needed[Insert the approved treatment of unrestricted funds and the process for changes to a supported program.]

Receipts and acknowledgements

A payment-provider confirmation is a payment acknowledgement. The foundation’s authorised contribution receipt will follow the approved recordkeeping process. Tax-benefit information will be provided only where it has been verified as applicable.

05 / Donation & Refund Policy

Payment issues and duplicate transactions

Preview · confirmation neededIf a payment appears unsuccessful or duplicated, check its status with your payment provider and contact [Donation support email] before attempting another transaction. Include the transaction reference, date and amount. Do not send card numbers, passwords or one-time passcodes.
